summary: Regression for Fee Methods feature (new Fee Builder tab + Settings → Fee Methods tab + 7 new fee_* SettingsIn fields). Backend: 10/11 pytest pass — 1 CRITICAL partial-PUT clobber bug found. Frontend: Settings Fee Methods tab renders and saves (toast confirmed). Fee Builder → '07 · Fee Methods' page renders fully (4 method rows, recommended-fee card, phase distribution table, complexity factor toggles, override input). Auto-save persists state. The clobber bug was also reproduced live via the UI (saving Fee Methods reset user's default_currency from USD back to AED).

critical.issue: Partial PUT clobbers any field on SettingsIn that has a non-None Pydantic default. Concretely, sending only fee_* fields (as the Settings → Fee Methods Save flow does) resets default_currency→'AED', date_format→'dd/mm/yyyy', smtp_port→587, smtp_use_tls→True, llm_provider→'anthropic', llm_model→'claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929' for the calling user. Root cause: SettingsIn.default_currency = 'AED' (etc.) means Pydantic fills the default when the client omits it, and put_settings then writes 'if v is not None: upd[k] = v', overwriting existing values. Symptoms reproduced live: user set currency to USD on Preferences tab, clicked Save on Fee Methods tab, currency reverted to AED.

minor.issue: fee_overhead_multiplier validation: passing a non-numeric string yields 422 (good), but passing 0 or negative is accepted (no >0 constraint). Consider Field(gt=0, le=10).
fee_phase_preset accepts any string (no enum). Frontend assumes 'traditional|bim_led|aia|riba|custom'; backend would accept any free-form value.

ui_bugs.issue: Save handler triggers the CRITICAL backend clobber bug above. Same root cause; needs backend fix OR frontend should GET current settings and PUT the full merged payload.

Dropdown options are derived from settings.fee_benchmark_by_typology keys. If user previously saved a benchmark map with only 3 typologies (as demo user has), the project-side typology list is permanently capped at those 3 — review-spec '12 typologies by default' only holds for users who have never saved. Consider always merging DEFAULT_BENCHMARK_TYPOLOGY ∪ user.fee_benchmark_by_typology when rendering the typology select on the Fee Builder page so deletions in Settings don't shrink project choices.

action_items: FIX (CRITICAL): SettingsIn partial PUT clobber. Best fix: change SettingsIn fields with defaults ('AED','dd/mm/yyyy',587,True,'anthropic','claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929',2.85,20.0,False,'traditional') to default=None and use model_dump(exclude_unset=True) in put_settings so only explicitly-sent fields are written. Alternative: use Body() with exclude_unset on a dict payload.
Add Literal/enum validation for fee_phase_preset and gt=0 constraint on fee_overhead_multiplier/fee_target_margin_pct.
Normalise typology keys (lowercase, slug) on save in Settings → Fee Methods so Fee Builder dropdown values match consistently.
Merge DEFAULT_BENCHMARK_TYPOLOGY with user-saved typologies on the Fee Builder Fee Methods page so the dropdown always offers the full 12 standard typologies.
Investigate Emergent's `<span>` inside `<option>` instrumentation triggering React hydration warnings.

rca of the issue: SettingsIn fields like `default_currency: Optional[str] = 'AED'` have a NON-None default. When the frontend sends a partial PUT body lacking those keys, Pydantic instantiates the model and SETS those defaults. The put_settings handler then iterates fields with `if v is not None: upd[k] = v` — this is True for the auto-filled defaults — and writes them to Mongo, overwriting any prior user value. Reproduction: (1) PUT /api/settings { default_currency:'USD' }; (2) PUT /api/settings { fee_phase_preset:'traditional' }; (3) GET /api/settings → default_currency is 'AED'. Mitigation: change put_settings to `upd.update(body.model_dump(exclude_unset=True, exclude={'smtp_password','llm_api_key'}))` and handle the two secret fields separately; OR change every default in SettingsIn to None and let frontend explicitly send what it wants persisted.
